name: beatmap
description: Discover hip-hop & street dance events (battles, workshops, shows) as a list or on a map.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @beatmap/api" "npm run dev -w @beatmap/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @beatmap/api && npm run build -w @beatmap/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w @beatmap/api" "npm run start -w @beatmap/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @beatmap/api && npm run typecheck -w @beatmap/web
